jsonLd.name: Fotona Wart Removal in Miami
jsonLd.description: Fotona laser wart removal in Miami at Real Aesthetic. Precise removal of common warts and benign skin lesions, supervised by Ronal Perdomo Lugo, APRN, FNP-C.

acceptedAnswer.text: Scarring is significantly less common than with electrocautery or surgical excision because the laser ablates layer by layer with precise control. Following the aftercare instructions — gentle wound care, sun protection, no picking — supports a clean healing process. Some lesions may leave a small mark that fades over months.

mainEntity.name: How many sessions will I need?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most warts resolve in 1 to 3 sessions. Plantar warts and larger lesions sometimes require more. We assess and recommend a plan in the consultation. Sessions are usually spaced 3 to 4 weeks apart to allow the skin to recover between treatments.

There is a brief stinging sensation during the laser pulses. We apply topical anaesthetic before the session and the discomfort is generally well tolerated. After the session there may be mild burning that subsides within hours.

hero.title: Fotona Wart Removal in Miami
hero.lede: Fotona Er:YAG laser precisely ablates common warts and small benign skin lesions in one to three sessions, with minimal scarring and a clean healing process.

blocks.title: What it does for you
list: Removes common warts (verruca vulgaris), plantar warts, and other benign skin lesions.
Highly precise — only the lesion is targeted, surrounding skin is preserved.
Most lesions resolve in 1 to 3 sessions depending on size, depth, and location.
Quick in-office procedure, typically 15 to 30 minutes per session.
Lower recurrence rate than cryotherapy in many cases and minimal scarring with proper aftercare.
Suitable for face, hands, feet, and other areas where precision matters.
